title: The Librarians
description:
S02 E05 — And the Hollow Men
Flynn is kidnapped by a mysterious stranger with both amnesia and a collection of the library's missing artifacts; the group pursues the Staff of Zarathustra.

title: The Librarians
description:
S02 E06 — And the Infernal Contract
Baird's old friend finds himself embroiled in a scandal in the form of a missing intern and a contract with the devil; Baird must battle for the souls of all the librarians.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S03 E02 — The Digital Frankenstein Job
The team conducts a sting to snare a corrupt judge by using the perfect undercover briber, a completely virtual tech visionary generated by A.I.; they watch as their "Digital Frankenstein" quickly spins out of control.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S03 E03 — The Scared Stiff Job
Our team runs the "Christmas Carol" con on a wannabe cryonics mogul who coerces dying patients into exploitative contracts bankrupting the loved ones they leave behind.

title: The Librarians: The Next Chapter
description:
S01 E05 — And the Memory Crystal
The team goes to a college campus with a world-class observatory to discover who is using the Crystal of Dr. John Dee to steal people's memories, in order to own the future.

title: The Librarians: The Next Chapter
description:
S01 E06 — And the House of Cards
When the magic door reroutes Charlie, Lysa and Connor to a bizarre manor where a series of Agatha Christie-style murders take place, they must figure out whodunit, while Vikram tries to track them down with the help of a mysterious tarot card reader.

title: The Messenger
description:
S01 E04
Completing the second ace builds Ed's confidence, and unexpectedly leads him closer to his estranged family, only to spin him further away.

title: The Messenger
description:
S01 E05
The arrival of a third ace convinces Ed the cards are his true calling, something that alienates his friends and puts all his relationships at risk.

title: The Ark
description:
S01 E09 — The Painful Way
After an unpopular decision, discord gives way to deadly mutiny in which loyalties are tested.

title: The Ark
description:
S01 E10 — Hoping for Forever
The situation onboard Ark One seems hopeless after crew members are taken hostage.

title: Leverage
description:
S01 E07 — The Wedding Job
The team poses as wedding planners to get close to a Mafia boss and must pull off a wedding while pulling off the heist.

title: Leverage
description:
S01 E09 — The Snow Job
The team goes after a construction company that foreclosed on a National Guardsman's home; Nate puts the team in jeopardy with his drinking.

title: Eyes of the Roshi
description: A fugitive grandmaster has to summon his inner warrior to defeat an assassin.

title: The Ark
description:
S01 E11 — The Last Thing You Ever Do
The crew must understand their enemy better as they attempt a dangerous rescue mission.

title: The Ark
description:
S01 E12 — Everybody Wins
In the Season 1 finale, brokering peace with their adversary could cost the Ark One everything.

title: The Librarians: The Next Chapter
description:
S01 E07 — And the Con-Con
Connor is forced to reconnect with people from his pre-Library life, and must defeat an old adversary who has grown powerful in his absence.

title: The Librarians: The Next Chapter
description:
S01 E08 — And the Hangover From Hell
After a bachelorette party with Lysa's childhood best friend, the team wakes up in rough shape and hungover, with no idea how they ended up where they are.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S03 E04 — The Hustler Job
The crew takes on a phone scamming ring that uses deepfake technology to con their marks, run by an old school hustler who came up via the pool hall circuit; to infiltrate his organization, they have to best him on and off the felt.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S03 E05 — The Grand Complication Job
When Sophie is abducted, rivals Parker and Astrid are forced into a desperate race against time to save her by securing the elusive Marie Antoinette watch; unaware of each other's involvement, they embark on a high stakes quest to save Sophie.
